title: Tor & Dark Web Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk when using Tor browser and accessing the dark web. Get personalized security recommendations and risk assessment.
description: Evaluate your privacy and security risks when using Tor browser for anonymous browsing and dark web access. This calculator analyzes your setup, browsing habits, and security practices to provide a comprehensive risk score and actionable recommendations.

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your Tor privacy risk based on configuration settings, usage patterns, operating system security, and browsing habits. It considers factors like software versions, JavaScript settings, VPN usage, personal information sharing, and dark web access patterns to provide a comprehensive risk assessment.
tips: Always use the latest version of Tor browser with default security settings
Never install browser extensions or plugins in Tor browser
Use Tails OS or a dedicated Linux system for maximum anonymity
Disable JavaScript and avoid downloading files through Tor
Never log into personal accounts or share identifying information
Consider the legal implications of accessing certain dark web content
Use Incognito Browser for everyday privacy needs and reserve Tor for specific anonymity requirements
Regularly restart Tor browser to get new circuit paths
